sections.heading: Validate exposure beyond your perimeter
sections.body:
VajraX is our AI-powered exposure validation product for the external attack surface. It is for organisations looking to validate exposure across that external attack surface.

Part of our [Cyber Security](/services/cyber-security) portfolio, VajraX brings our own software alongside specialist security services.

Available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement.
